content.short: A SHIB is a Cardano meme token inspired by Shiba Inu, cyberpunk branding, utility goals, and DeFi tools.
content.description: A SHIB is a Cardano meme-token project inspired by the Shiba Inu brand and positioned as a Cardano-native counterpart with its own community identity. Its messaging emphasizes Cardano's low fees, the Extended UTXO model, and a broader push toward utility beyond meme culture, including verification, network participation, and yield-oriented features. The token is presented as a hard-capped asset with no minting function, combining meme branding with a more utility-focused Cardano narrative.
